beschreibung.message: Send selected text, the page, an image or a screenshot to PixiNotes as a card – no server, straight into the open tab.

knopf.message: Send this page to PixiNotes (right-click: visible area as image)

menueBildschirm.message: Send visible area as image to PixiNotes

bildNichtLadbar.message: The image could not be loaded – here is its address.

fehlerKeineBerechtigung.message: Permission for this PixiNotes address is missing. Images only arrive with permission – please save the options again.

fehlerNichtAngekommen.message: PixiNotes did not accept the item. Is the address in the options correct?

optAdresseHinweis.message: Default: the web app on GitHub Pages. Your own address (e.g. self-hosted) needs your consent once.

optDirekt.message: Put it on the open board without asking

optDirektHinweis.message: Otherwise PixiNotes asks every time which board it should go to.

optUngueltig.message: Please enter an address starting with http:// or https://.

optAbgelehnt.message: Saved, but without permission: text and links arrive, images do not.

optDatenschutz.message: The extension sends nothing to the internet: items only go to the PixiNotes tab in this browser. No tracking.
